items.html: And behold, all this is during the time of pregnancy and the time of nursing. For the membranes are Elokim, judgments, and the lights, which are HaVaYot, are the Mochin. And even though we always say that the Mochin of pregnancy and nursing are names of Elokim, this is not regarding the Mochin themselves, for the Mochin are truly HaVaYot even in pregnancy and nursing. Rather, the intention is regarding those sparks, which are names of Elokim, and are entirely judgments. And remember this rule.
